## Status Legend

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `UNVERIFIED` | From anchor paper(s), not yet searched in current literature |
| `SEARCHING` | Active literature search in progress |
| `SUPPORTED_AS_CURRENT_GAP` | Confirmed still open by independent literature evidence |
| `PARTIALLY_RESOLVED` | Partially addressed by recent prior work |
| `RESOLVED_BY_PRIOR_WORK` | Gap no longer exists — solved by existing work |
| `INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE` | Cannot determine gap status from available literature |

**NEVER promote UNVERIFIED → SUPPORTED_AS_CURRENT_GAP without literature evidence.**
